title: Solana Decentralized Escrow Protocol V2 - Hackathon Proof Startup
description: Milestone-gated crowdfunding on Solana Devnet with strictly ordered tranches, autonomous backer governance, on-chain accounting, and pro-rata investor refund guarantees.

milestones.title: Tranche 1: Core Architecture & Devnet Deployment (40%)
milestones.description: Deployment of the upgradeable V2 Anchor escrow program on Solana Devnet, ProtocolConfigV2 setup, and canonical Arweave terms sealing.

milestones.title: Tranche 2: Milestone Evidence & Backer Voting Engine (30%)
milestones.description: Integration of decentralized evidence submission, 7-day cryptographic backer voting rounds, and revision handling.

milestones.title: Tranche 3: Security Audits & Production Release (30%)
milestones.description: Formal program security review, final milestone verification, split multi-recipient payouts, and emergency pro-rata refund tests.
